prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a rear-end collision claim. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1127; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss for rear-end collision. Insured reports being stopped at a red light when the vehicle behind made contact at low speed. Insured states no airbags deployed and both vehicles were drivable from the scene. Police report requested.

Entry 2: Claimant is now represented by counsel. Letter of representation received. All further contact to be routed through the attorney's office. Claimant reports neck strain following the impact and has started conservative treatment. Medical authorization requested through counsel.

Entry 3: Spoke with defense-side counsel regarding liability. Rear vehicle driver admitted following too closely and not stopping in time. Liability appears clear against the rear driver. Photos of both vehicles reviewed, damage consistent with reported impact speed. Repair estimate on insured vehicle pending.

Entry 4: Received medical records from claimant's treating provider through counsel. Diagnosis listed as cervical strain with muscle spasm. Treatment plan includes physical therapy sessions over several weeks. Records reviewed and noted for injury evaluation. Requested prior medical history for the same body region to assess pre-existing conditions.

Entry 5: Counsel submitted a demand package including medical bills, wage loss documentation, and treatment summary. Demand is under review. Reserve adjusted to reflect current injury status and projected treatment duration. Scheduled file review with supervisor. Will follow up with counsel once evaluation is complete.
